senses.gloss: Proshaka, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 376 (in the north-east).
Proshṭha, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 369 (in the south).

Proshṭhapadā, dual and pl., name of a double nakshatra (= Bhādrapadā). § 565 (Gālavacarita): V, 114, 3898 (ºābhyāṃ).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 3, 82 (Śukraḥ Pºe pūrve samāruhya virocate uttare tu parikramya sahitaḥ samudīkshyate (omens); = Pūrvabhādrapadānakshatraṃ and Uttarabhādrapadānakshatraṃ, Nīl., C. by error has Prauº).--§ 749 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 89, 4267 (pūrva-Pº āḥ…uttarāsu, merit of performing śrāddhas under the constellation of P.).-§ 759 (do.): XIII, 104, 5082 (ºayoḥ, no śrāddha should be performed under the constellation of P.). Cf. Bhādrapadā.
